pm.title: Will there be no change in Fed interest rates after the September 2026 meeting?

k.title: Will the Federal Reserve Cut rates by 25bps at their September 2026 meeting? Cut 25bps
k.rules: If the Federal Reserve does a Cut of 25bps on September 16, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
